## Automated Tests Required

### Story 001: FeedbackMath — Logic
**Test file path**: `tests/unit/feedback/feedback_math_test.gd`
**What to test**: the 8 embedded AC specs in the story file (GDD worked example 0.646; bounded linear ratio; log clamp; max-not-sum; zero-delta lowest tier; **sign-invariance** — the GDD's central no-valence guarantee; tier boundaries 0.3/0.7; deterministic fuzz clamp sweep).
**Edge cases**: empty dict, unknown resource keys (treated as unbounded, never crash), ±1e6 extremes, exact boundary values 0.3/0.7.
**Estimated test count**: ~12–15 unit tests.
*Test specs are already embedded in the story's `## QA Test Cases` — implement against those, do not invent new ones.*

### Story 002: Action channel — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/action_ui/resource_hud_feedback_test.gd`
**What to test**: the 6 embedded AC specs (count-up + flash on action_completed, no shake; start = end − reward derivation with resource_changed snap suppression; sign-invariant presentation params; zero-magnitude still flashes; tween pile-up guard; `self_modulate`-not-`modulate` assertion).
**Estimated test count**: ~7–8 integration tests.

### Story 003: Card channel — Integration
**Test file path**: `tests/integration/card_ui/card_feedback_test.gd`
**What to test**: the 8 embedded AC specs (tier gating 0.1/0.5/0.9 + boundaries; scale returns to ONE incl. interrupt; direct-resolve pivot; rest-position return; no-valence param identity; null-stream guard; backgrounding kill during RESOLVING; payoff clamp verification at lengths 0/30/60/200).
**Estimated test count**: ~10–12 integration tests.

### 9-3: Test isolation — Infra property test
**What to test**: with a deliberately polluted save (Cringe=100, milestones set, active path T2) present in the test environment, the FULL suite passes. This is the regression that produced 3 false failures on 2026-07-05.
**Evidence**: a documented full-suite run in the story close; optionally a fixture save committed under `tests/fixtures/`.

## Manual QA Checklist

### Story 003 — Feel evidence (Visual/Feel advisory addendum)
**Verification method**: editor/device walkthrough + screenshots/video
**Who must sign off**: solo dev (all roles)
**Evidence to capture**: `production/qa/evidence/juice-card-feel-evidence.md`

Checklist:
- [ ] Feel-1: low/mid/high magnitude resolutions read as increasing "weight" — screenshot/video per tier
- [ ] Feel-2: during max shake, option labels/buttons remain tappable at layout positions (touch targets undisplaced)
- [ ] Feel-3: blind valence test — feedback-only observation (text obscured) cannot distinguish big win from big disaster at equal magnitude

### 9-4 — PL→EN audit spot-check
- [ ] All action names, card texts, HUD labels, toasts render in English in a live run
- [ ] Audit report lists every player-facing string source scanned

## Smoke Test Scope

1. Game launches to action screen without crash
2. Fresh save starts clean
3. **Action completes → count-up + pill flash play; no shake** (primary Sprint 9 mechanic)
4. **Card resolves → pulse (+shake at higher magnitude); payoff beat unchanged** (primary mechanic)
5. Class Path badge still appears/persists (Sprint 8 regression guard)
6. Save/load cycle completes without data loss
7. Full suite green WITH a real playtest save present (9-3 acceptance)

## Definition of Done — This Sprint

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — automated test result OR documented manual evidence
- [ ] Test file exists at the specified path for all Logic and Integration stories
- [ ] Feel evidence doc exists for story-003's Visual/Feel addendum
- [ ] Smoke check passes (`/smoke-check sprint` before QA hand-off)
- [ ] No regressions (full suite 360+ green, including with polluted save after 9-3)
- [ ] Code reviewed (`/code-review` or documented peer review)
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` (via `/story-done`)
- [ ] **Wiring rule (Sprint 8 retro)**: no new Autoload this sprint (ADR-0011), so the wiring AC is N/A — but any deviation introducing one re-triggers the rule
